prompts.level_1: Identify the immediate traversal, dodge, attack, guard, skill, flask, item, armament, interaction, revive, targeting, or menu goal while respecting visible animation commitment.
prompts.level_2: Describe the broader combat exchange, exploration route, looting, recovery, team support, or expedition sub-goal.
prompts.level_3: State the long-horizon expedition, boss, survival, progression, preparation, or exploration objective.
prompts.continuity: Merge combat actions only when they belong to the same encounter and expedition objective; split on a new encounter, boss phase reset, death/results flow, hub/menu transition, or unrelated destination.
